extra_vocab.en: a small place where you can buy coffee, tea, and light meals
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於約客戶見面、午餐地點與店家廣告。也可寫成沒有重音符號的 cafe，意思相同。

example.en: Many cafés in this area offer free Wi-Fi to customers.
example.zh: 這一帶許多咖啡館提供顧客免費無線網路。

example.en: Let's meet at a café near the station at noon.
example.zh: 我們中午約在車站附近的咖啡館見面吧。

example.en: She plans to open a café in the old bookstore building.
example.zh: 她打算在舊書店的大樓裡開一家咖啡館。

example.en: The café menu changes every month, so please check the board.
example.zh: 咖啡館的菜單每個月更換，請看看板。

examples.en: The client asked us to meet at a café downtown.
examples.zh: 客戶要我們約在市區的一家咖啡館見面。

examples.en: We had lunch at a small café after the workshop.
examples.zh: 工作坊結束後，我們在一家小咖啡館吃了午餐。

examples.en: Our new café offers free Wi-Fi and fresh cakes every day.
examples.zh: 我們的新咖啡館每天提供免費無線網路和新鮮蛋糕。

examples.en: There is a quiet café across the street from the hotel.
examples.zh: 飯店對面有一家安靜的咖啡館。

confusable.diff: coffee 是咖啡這種飲料；café 是賣咖啡和簡餐的地方。

example.en: I need a cup of coffee before the morning meeting.
example.zh: 早上的會議前，我需要一杯咖啡。

confusable.diff: cafeteria 是公司或學校的自助式員工餐廳；café 是對外營業的小店。

example.en: The company cafeteria serves lunch from eleven to two.
example.zh: 公司餐廳從十一點到兩點供應午餐。

similar.diff: 意思幾乎相同，coffee shop 較口語，café 常帶有簡餐或較有氣氛的感覺。

example.en: The coffee shop next door opens at seven every morning.
example.zh: 隔壁的咖啡店每天早上七點開門。

example.en: We booked a table at the restaurant for six.
example.zh: 我們在餐廳訂了一張六人桌。

example.en: The bakery on the corner sells fresh bread every morning.
example.zh: 轉角的麵包店每天早上都賣新鮮麵包。

example.en: Could you show us the lunch menu, please?
example.zh: 可以請你給我們看午餐菜單嗎？

extra_vocab.en: a small machine that does math for you
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於辦公室、會計、採購與文具廣告，也常出現在手機的計算機 app。

example.en: The store sells calculators, pens, and other office supplies.
example.zh: 這家店賣計算機、筆和其他辦公用品。

example.en: You can use a calculator to check the total price.
example.zh: 你可以用計算機核對總價。

example.en: Try the online calculator to see your monthly loan payment.
example.zh: 試試線上計算器，看看你每月的貸款還款額。

example.en: He keeps a pocket calculator in his bag for quick sums.
example.zh: 他的包包裡放著一台口袋計算機，方便快速計算。

examples.en: I left my calculator on the desk in the meeting room.
examples.zh: 我把計算機留在會議室的桌上了。

examples.en: The accountant checked the numbers again with a calculator.
examples.zh: 會計人員又用計算機核對了一次數字。

examples.en: Calculators are not allowed during the final exam.
examples.zh: 期末考期間不得使用計算機。

examples.en: This solar calculator never needs batteries and costs only five dollars.
examples.zh: 這台太陽能計算機不需要電池，只要五美元。

confusable.diff: 拼法相近，但 calendar 是「日曆、行事曆」，不是用來算數字的工具。

example.en: Please put the meeting on my calendar for Friday.
example.zh: 請把這場會議排進我星期五的行事曆。

example.en: My computer is too slow to open this file.
example.zh: 我的電腦太慢，打不開這個檔案。

example.en: I sent you the budget spreadsheet this morning.
example.zh: 我今天早上把預算試算表寄給你了。

derived.link: calculate 是基礎字，calculator = calculate + -or，做計算的東西，像 actor、visitor

extra_vocab.en: an official paper that shows you finished a course or passed a test
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於訓練課程、保固、資格證明與公司文件。gift certificate（禮券）也是常見用法。

example.en: All certificates will be mailed to the participants next month.
example.zh: 所有證書下個月會寄給參加者。

example.en: The school will issue a certificate after you finish the course.
example.zh: 你完成課程後，學校會核發證書。

example.en: She won a gift certificate for dinner at the new restaurant.
example.zh: 她贏得了一張新餐廳的晚餐禮券。

example.en: Please bring your certificate of completion to the front desk.
example.zh: 請把你的結業證書帶到櫃台。

examples.en: Each employee received a certificate after the safety training.
examples.zh: 每位員工在安全訓練後都拿到了證書。

examples.en: Please attach a copy of your teaching certificate to the form.
examples.zh: 請在表格上附上你的教師證書影本。

examples.en: The warranty certificate is inside the box with the manual.
examples.zh: 保固書和說明書一起放在盒子裡。

confusable.diff: certificate 是一張具體的證書；certification 指取得認證的過程或資格。
confusable.usage: certificate 是可數名詞（a certificate），certification 多半當不可數名詞，指「認證」這件事。

example.en: Our factory is preparing for safety certification next month.
example.zh: 我們工廠正在準備下個月的安全認證。

similar.diff: diploma 是學校的畢業證書；certificate 多指結業或資格證明，範圍較廣。

example.en: She hung her diploma on the wall of her new office.
example.zh: 她把畢業證書掛在新辦公室的牆上。

example.en: You need a license to drive the company truck.
example.zh: 你需要有駕照才能開公司的卡車。

example.en: She has a degree in business from a local university.
example.zh: 她有當地大學的商學學位。

example.en: This printer comes with a two-year warranty.
example.zh: 這台印表機附兩年保固。

derived.link: certify 是動詞，和 certificate 同一詞幹 cert-，證明某事為真，像 identify、verify
certify + -cation，動詞變名詞，像 identify → identification

senses.en: an official paper that shows you finished a course or passed a test

example.en: He earned a certificate in accounting after six months of study.
example.zh: 他學習六個月後取得了會計證書。

senses.en: a paper that you can use instead of money in a store
senses.distinguish: 前面有 gift，或後面接 for + 店名、金額時，指的是禮券，不是證書。

example.en: The gift certificate is good for fifty dollars at any branch.
example.zh: 這張禮券可在任何分店折抵五十美元。

senses.en: an official paper that shows an important fact
senses.distinguish: 前面有 birth、marriage、health 等字時，指的是官方的證明文件。

example.en: You must show your birth certificate when you apply for a passport.
example.zh: 申請護照時，你必須出示出生證明。

extra_vocab.en: giving help or money to people who need it
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於公司公告、新聞與活動宣傳，如 charitable organization、charitable event。語氣正式、正面。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: charitable 是形容詞，修飾名詞（a charitable group）；表示「慈善事業或機構」的名詞是 charity。

example.en: The charitable organization helps families who lost their homes.
example.zh: 這個慈善機構幫助失去家園的家庭。

example.en: We made a charitable donation of five hundred dollars.
example.zh: 我們捐出了五百美元的慈善捐款。

example.en: Our charitable event will raise money for local schools.
example.zh: 我們的慈善活動會為當地學校籌款。

examples.en: The company is proud of its charitable work in the community.
examples.zh: 公司為它在社區的慈善工作感到驕傲。

examples.en: A charitable group gave free meals to workers after the storm.
examples.zh: 暴風雨過後，一個慈善團體提供免費餐點給工人。

examples.en: Please join our charitable dinner on Friday evening.
examples.zh: 請參加我們週五晚上的慈善晚宴。

examples.en: Part of our profit goes to charitable programs every year.
examples.zh: 我們每年有部分利潤會用在慈善計畫上。

similar.diff: generous 形容人大方、願意給予，不限於慈善；charitable 常指慈善事業或機構。

example.en: The generous donor gave a large gift to the hospital.
example.zh: 這位慷慨的捐款人送給醫院一筆大額捐款。

similar.diff: nonprofit 說明組織「不以營利為目的」；charitable 強調幫助有需要的人。

example.en: The nonprofit group runs a free training center for youth.
example.zh: 這個非營利團體開辦了一個免費的青年訓練中心。

example.en: Thank you for your donation to the school fund.
example.zh: 謝謝您捐款給學校基金。

example.en: Fifty volunteers helped us clean the park on Sunday.
example.zh: 五十位志工星期天幫我們打掃公園。

example.en: The fund will help students who cannot pay for school.
example.zh: 這筆基金會幫助付不起學費的學生。

derived.link: charity 是基礎字；去掉 -y，加 -able，變成形容詞「慈善的」，像 comfortable

extra_vocab.en: a place where people go to watch films
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於休閒活動、廣告與公司聚會，cinema 是英式說法，美式常說 movie theater。也可指電影這門藝術或產業。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: 指「電影院」時常說 go to the cinema，要加 the；指電影藝術或產業時通常不加 the。

example.en: Several cinemas in the city offer discounts to students.
example.zh: 市內有幾家電影院提供學生折扣。

example.en: We plan to go to the cinema after the office party.
example.zh: 我們打算辦公室派對結束後去看電影。

example.en: Employees can get a cinema ticket at half price on Mondays.
example.zh: 員工星期一可以半價買到電影票。

example.en: The local cinema will show the new film starting Friday.
example.zh: 當地電影院從星期五開始上映這部新片。

examples.en: Let's meet in front of the cinema at seven o'clock.
examples.zh: 我們七點在電影院前面碰面吧。

examples.en: Show this card at the cinema to get a free drink.
examples.zh: 在電影院出示這張卡片可獲得一杯免費飲料。

examples.en: Our company booked the whole cinema for a team event.
examples.zh: 我們公司包下整間電影院舉辦團隊活動。

similar.diff: 意思相同，movie theater 是美式說法，cinema 是英式說法。

example.en: Is there a movie theater near the hotel?
example.zh: 飯店附近有電影院嗎？

similar.diff: the movies 是口語說法，常用於 go to the movies（去看電影）。

example.en: Let's go to the movies after dinner tonight.
example.zh: 今晚吃完晚餐後我們去看電影吧。

example.en: The film starts at eight and ends at ten.
example.zh: 這部電影八點開始，十點結束。

example.en: I bought two tickets for the Saturday show.
example.zh: 我買了兩張星期六場次的票。

example.en: The cinema has a very large screen.
example.zh: 這家電影院的銀幕非常大。

senses.en: a building where people watch films

example.en: The cinema has ten screens and a large parking lot.
example.zh: 這家電影院有十個影廳和一個大停車場。

senses.en: films as an art or a business
senses.distinguish: 前面有 Asian、modern 等形容詞，或不加冠詞 the 時，指電影這門藝術或產業，不是一棟建築。

example.en: Asian cinema has become popular with audiences around the world.
example.zh: 亞洲電影在全世界的觀眾之間變得受歡迎。
